# Hiring Plan: Coastal Mangrove Programme (2 Years)

## Grant Parameters

| Item | Amount (USD) | Amount (KES)* |
|------|-----------|---------------|
| Total Grant | $180,000 | KES 25,200,000 |
| Maximum Indirect (15%) | $27,000 | KES 3,780,000 |
| **Direct Cost Ceiling** | **$153,000** | **KES 21,420,000** |

*Exchange rate: 1 USD = 140 KES (conservative estimate for budgeting)

---

## Statutory Employer On-Costs (Kenya)

| Contribution | Rate | Applied To |
|-------------|------|-----------|
| NSSF (Pension) | 6% of gross | First KES 18,000 only |
| NHIF (Health) | Fixed tier | Based on salary band |
| PAYE | Deducted at source | Employee liability (not employer cost) |
| **Total Employer Burden** | **~7-9%** | Varies by salary |

*Note: Housing Levy (1.5%) was stayed by courts; excluded pending clarity*

---

## Key Assumptions & Risks

| Assumption | Mitigation |
|-----------|-----------|
| Exchange rate 140 KES/USD | Build 5% forex buffer; negotiate payment timing |
| Statutory rates stable | Monitor Finance Act 2024; budget 10% flexibility |
| No salary inflation | Review at Month 12; use contingency if needed |
| Roles fillable in timeline | Begin recruitment Month 0; use networks |

---

## Recommendations

1. **Recruit PM immediately** — critical for programme design and donor reporting
2. **Prioritize local coastal hires** for Field Coordinator and Mobilisers to ensure community trust
3. **M&E Officer at 0.6 FTE** — sufficient for this scale; can increase if monitoring demands exceed expectations
4. **Document time allocation rigorously** — ED and Finance roles split between direct/indirect require timesheets
5. **Review at Month 12** — assess if savings allow extension of Mobilisers or additional community investment
